name: Wireless Rechargeable RGB Gaming Mouse (7 Buttons)
shortDescription: Rechargeable 2.4G wireless gaming mouse with RGB lighting and 7 buttons.
description: A 2.4G wireless gaming mouse with a built-in rechargeable battery, 7 programmable-style buttons and striking RGB lighting. No batteries to buy, and the supplier advertises up to 15 days of use per charge.
highlights: Up to 15 days per charge (as advertised)
